name: Yukinomiya Anon
source:
Screen name: Anonym
Class: Paladin

Transfer student that sits behind [url=/c18358]Shuuho[/url]. Under her sister [url=/c48143]Ayame's[/url] instructions, she bought the game Wizard Generation for him. She looks like a normal transfer student but she is actually a huge game addict. For her interesting things are a top priority, and when faced with troubles she will put it off. In other words, she is quite dumb. 

She plays as the Paladin class in Wizard Generation that can use priest incantations. In order to look "cool", she equipped the katana "Tachibana" way too early in the game, which is why she had a difficulty playing at first. Because she wears a miko dress in-game, Anon calls herself a Japanese Paladin.

[spoiler] Anon and Ouka are blood related relatives [/spoiler]
